title: D5: cost per task and per goal in the scorecard, including Planner spend from transcripts
spec:
Why: nobody could see that reviews cost as much as execution or that the Planner was 80 percent of the token metric until it was computed by hand on 2026-09-18. Extend orchestrator/scorecard.py: build() also aggregates runs by task (usd, tokens, wall, role, tier) and by goal (sum over children plus the goal's own planner runs from .orchestrator/runs/planner_runs.json and planner transcript tallies from C-O7a's pool_state planner_day_tokens when present); `orchestrator scorecard --by task|goal` prints a table sorted by usd with a total line and, for --by goal, the split execute/review/scout/spec_review/planner in percent. cli.py: add the two choices. tests/test_scorecard.py: by_task_sums_runs, by_goal_splits_by_role_and_includes_planner_runs, missing_planner_data_prints_dash_not_zero. README.md: one line under "Run it".
(Recreated from T-0114: re-pointed at the recreated C-O4 and C-O7a)
acceptance: tests/test_scorecard.py gains the three named tests; green
`uv run orchestrator scorecard --by goal` on the fixture prints one row per goal with the role split in percent and a total
`uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` green; no new dependency
